source_name: Nukta Business, 'PSX Surges 2.8% | Reko Diq Update Boosts OGDC & PPL | HBL Presents Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-29)

fact_text: Pakistan has no other listed telecom company, so there is no local benchmark for valuation, which the guest said makes the sector harder to judge.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PSX Surges 2.8% | Reko Diq Update Boosts OGDC & PPL | HBL Presents Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-29)

fact_text: The research house Chase Securities published a PTC report on 25 Nov 2025 arguing that the sector is consolidating and that ARPU will rise.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PSX Surges 2.8% | Reko Diq Update Boosts OGDC & PPL | HBL Presents Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-29)

fact_text: PTCL agreed to acquire Telenor Pakistan, a deal announced in Dec 2023, and the guest said it has conditional competition approval with PTA approval the remaining step.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PSX Surges 2.8% | Reko Diq Update Boosts OGDC & PPL | HBL Presents Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-29)

fact_text: Media reports suggested PTA approval could come in early Dec 2025, and the guest used that as the expected timing.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PSX Surges 2.8% | Reko Diq Update Boosts OGDC & PPL | HBL Presents Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-29)

fact_text: In the first phase Telenor's financials would consolidate into PTC while Telenor stays a separate company until a scheme of amalgamation is approved, which the guest said will take time.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PSX Surges 2.8% | Reko Diq Update Boosts OGDC & PPL | HBL Presents Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-29)

fact_text: PTC's quarterly operating profit was near zero or negative in Dec 2023 and has risen above PKR 10 billion a quarter, according to the guest, even though the deal has not closed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PSX Surges 2.8% | Reko Diq Update Boosts OGDC & PPL | HBL Presents Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-29)

fact_text: PTC's reported earnings are depressed by other charges tied to provisioning and clean-up of certain lending, and the guest said earnings should show once that clean-up ends.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PSX Surges 2.8% | Reko Diq Update Boosts OGDC & PPL | HBL Presents Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-29)

fact_text: Each Rs 10 monthly rise in ARPU on about 70 million combined subscribers would add about Rs 8.4 billion pre-tax a year, about Rs 5.1 billion after tax, or about Rs 1 per share on about 5.1 billion shares.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PSX Surges 2.8% | Reko Diq Update Boosts OGDC & PPL | HBL Presents Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-29)

fact_text: The base case assumes combined PTC and Telenor ARPU of about Rs 280 in 2026, rising about 15% a year, while the guest said the actual rise could be faster.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PSX Surges 2.8% | Reko Diq Update Boosts OGDC & PPL | HBL Presents Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-29)

fact_text: The guest said consolidations typically remove about one third of operating costs, and put the Pakistan opportunity from PTC-Telenor consolidation at about PKR 60 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PSX Surges 2.8% | Reko Diq Update Boosts OGDC & PPL | HBL Presents Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-29)

fact_text: PTC's lawyers told the Competition Commission of Pakistan that the tower count would fall from about 24,000 to about 17,000 after consolidation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PSX Surges 2.8% | Reko Diq Update Boosts OGDC & PPL | HBL Presents Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-29)

fact_text: Sale of some PTC towers to a tower company could add value, but the guest said the base case excludes tower sales.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PSX Surges 2.8% | Reko Diq Update Boosts OGDC & PPL | HBL Presents Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-29)

fact_text: The base case assumes no execution efficiency gains from the merger and models growth mainly from higher ARPU, so cost savings are left out until they are seen.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PSX Surges 2.8% | Reko Diq Update Boosts OGDC & PPL | HBL Presents Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-29)

fact_text: Ufone was weak at winning market share but good at holding share and pricing, the guest said, which he argued supports PTC keeping subscribers after the merger.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PSX Surges 2.8% | Reko Diq Update Boosts OGDC & PPL | HBL Presents Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-29)

fact_text: An investor concern was that PTC's management could hurt Telenor's customers as it did with Ufone, which the guest answered by pointing to the merged base and pricing power.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PSX Surges 2.8% | Reko Diq Update Boosts OGDC & PPL | HBL Presents Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-29)

fact_text: Many investors held the stock in 2006 and then suffered heavy losses, which the guest said makes investors cautious about the sector.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PSX Surges 2.8% | Reko Diq Update Boosts OGDC & PPL | HBL Presents Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-29)
